def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Solver, Int, sat

    # Variables from base script
    folio_test_slab = Int('folio_test_slab')
    object = Int('object')

    # Variable from constraint set 1
    object_ptr = Int('object_ptr')

    s = Solver()

    # --- Base script constraints ---
    s.add(folio_test_slab == 0)
    s.add(object == 0)

    # --- Constraint set 1 constraints ---
    # object is NULL (object_ptr == 0), confirming early return path
    s.add(object_ptr == 0)
    # folio_test_slab is unconstrained (unreachable path), so no constraint added

    # --- Constraint set 2 constraints ---
    # !(ZERO_OR_NULL_PTR(object)): object != 0 AND object > ZERO_SIZE_PTR
    ZERO_SIZE_PTR = 16
    s.add(object != 0)
    s.add(object > ZERO_SIZE_PTR)

    result = s.check()
    return result == sat
